product_metadata.title: Stanbroil Graphite Impregnated Fiberglass Rope Seal and High Temperature Cement Gasket Kit Replacement for Wood Stoves - 1/2" x 84"
features: 【Package Includes】- Rope and 79ml bottle of gasket cement, for airtight stoves, fireplace inserts and coal or pellet stoves.
【Graphite Impregnated Fiberglass】- Makes gasket rope more abrasion resistant. , provide superior sealing, protection and longevity, highly flexible and conformable.
【High Temp Gasket Kit】- Will not burn and withstand to temperatures of 1000°F. The cement withstands 2000°F, adheres to all types of stoves from steel to cast iron.
【Perfect Replacement】- Stove door seal to keep your wood or pellet stove in top operating condition & maintain full burn efficiency.
【Excellent Customer Service】- We have professional team to offer you excellent service. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
